name: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1
summary: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is a new generation, powerful, superplastisizing concrete admixture for demanding concrete applications.
metaDescription: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is a new generation, powerful, superplastisizing concrete admixture for demanding concrete applications.
attributes: Very high water reduction can be used to achieve durability, high early and late-age strenghts, improved shrinkage and creep behaviour, lower cement contents and super-workable concrete mixes.
The neutral-set characteristics provide quicker setting and finishing times, high early strenghts and early stripping and demoulding of pre-cast products.

advantages: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 has the following characteristics and advantages:
Very high water reduction can be used to achieve durability, high early and late-age strenghts, improved shrinkage and creep behaviour, lower cement contents and super-workable concrete mixes.
The neutral-set characteristics provide quicker setting and finishing times, high early strenghts and early stripping and demoulding of pre-cast products.

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for High Range Water Reducer (HWR).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: At least one (1) year if stored in accordance with the recommendations given in 'Storage' below.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store at temperatures between 5oC and 35oC in unopened, original containers, protected from direct sunlight and frost.

items.label: Specific Advice
items.text:
Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 is added to the initial batch water. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at minimum wet-mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic metre.
The addition of the remaining guaging water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3rds of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in the concrete.
Sika recommend Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 be restricted for use in site-batched concrete or for short travel times, because of the early loss of workability.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-1 can be used in conjunction with the following Sika products:
Sika Plastiment Series
Sika Rapid
Sika Ferrogard 901
Sika Fume
Sika ViscoFlow
Sika Retarder
All admixtures must be added separately. Trial mixes are necessary to confirm plastic and hardened concrete properties.

items.label: Restrictions
items.text:
Do not use with naphthalene-based concrete admixtures.
Do not add to dry cement.
Trial mixes are necessary to ensure compliance with the required/specified plastic and hardened concrete properties.

items.label: Recommended Dosage
items.text: Typical dose rates range from 200-1000ml per 100kg of total cementitious material.
